summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of $350 million aggregate principal amount of 6.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 to qualified institutional buyers. The transaction closed May 20, 2026, under an indenture dated May 18, 2026, with subsidiary guarantors and U.S. Bank as trustee. Interest is payable quarterly; holders may convert at an initial rate of 20.7292 shares per $1,000 principal. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No premium, recommendation, or strategic event is involved.
